course_name: Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Course October 2023
detail: Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Course October 2023 HKCII/ICAC CPD - Oct 2023 - Google Forms We’re pleased to bring you yet another activity in the series commemorating the 30th anniversary of the HKCII, a CPD in collaboration with the ICAC called "Integrity for Success” - Continuing Professional Development Course for Insurance Intermediaries with Managerial Roles. This 2-hour CPD is categorized “Ethics or Regulations” and is free of charge.  After the class, there would be a 30-minute tour arranged by the ICAC in their Exhibition Hall for all participants.  Details of the class are as follows: Date:  Wed, 11 Oct 2023 Time: 3:00 pm – Registration 3:30 pm – CPD for 2 hours 5:30 pm – Tour of ICAC Exhibition Hall 6:00 pm – End Language:  Cantonese Venue:  ICAC Headquarters Building, 303 Java Road, North Point, Hong Kong (There will be ICAC personnel assisting participants on G/F when registration begins.) To enroll, please click on the link here below and enter the necessary info by Tue, 3 Oct 2023. HKCII/ICAC CPD - Oct 2023 - Google Forms Please note that: Your personal data would only be used for the purpose of enrolling the interested parties into the subject CPD class by HKCII & ICAC.  The successfully enrolled members will receive a confirmation email from HKCII after the enrollment period is closed, with all details necessary to participate in the CPD class. Seats are limited.  Enrollment to the CPD is on first-come-first-serve basis according to the time of full & accurate enrollment data received, and will be closed early once the class is filled. HKCII’s decision on the enrollment is final. Should you have any queries to the above, thanks to email me at anton@hkcii.org. ^ Top

course_name: Self - Learning CASH Selling Video
detail: Sales techniques developed through observation of highly successful people. Focused on identifying and uncovering customer needs in order to be able to position our products & services to match customer needs completely

course_name: Self-learning Courageous Conversations Videos
detail: Courageous Conversations program developed from skills observed in other training sessions as well as interviews with managers/supervisors and HR Managers from Multinational Organizations. Focused on helping people develop confidence & skills to have those difficult conversations and provide constructive feedback to help people around them develop and grow.

course_name: Self-learning Coaching Skills Videos
detail: Coaching skills developed through observation of highly successful coaches/trainers and past participants in a coaching capacity. Focused on supporting teams achieve their potential through working together effectively while enhancing their own personal skills for future growth.

course_name: Self-learning Influencing Without Authority Video
detail: Influencing Without Authority was developed in response to clients who were looking for enhancing the communication skills of their people especially in the area of influencing. People do not always have authority of others and so the skills needed to convince people to their way of thinking became critical for Managers & Supervisors. In fact the program has been expanded to people having to convince others in all walks of life and not just in the business context.
